title: Spinor Corrections b-C and a-C and the Choptyuk Problem
description: Computational verification and simulation of spinor corrections b-C (Berry, 1st order) and a-C (braking, 2nd order) on the Klein quartic curve, with the unified Choptyuk formula. Includes enumeration of all 64 spinor structures, applications to Bolza/Bring surfaces, and LIGO/Virgo quasi-normal mode predictions. Four independent implementations: Python, Julia, Java Spring Boot, Next.js interactive visualization.
notes: All verification results: Delta_bC = 3.438710 (dev 0.125%), Delta_Ch(full) = 3.447040 (dev 0.117%), b_Ch = 0.376510 (dev 0.130%).
